views.markdown: Warm light, right in Control Center. Tap Lantern to turn it on. Press and hold to adjust brightness with Apple's native intensity slider. Keep the stock flashlight for white light.

views.markdown:
Add Lantern using Control Center's editing controls. No Settings pane or preferences to configure.

Requires compatible CCSupport. Complete the documented activation step after installation on the tested Dopamine rootless configurations.

**iPhone SE (2nd generation)** — iOS 18.2 (22C152), Dopamine 3.0.10 rootless; physical white/warm/OFF verified. Reference CCSupport: 1.3.13-3~ios18fix1.

**iPhone 11 Pro Max** — iOS 18.3.2 (22D82), Dopamine 3 rootless, ElleKit 1.2, CCSupport installed: owner verified warm/OFF, native white ON/OFF and return to warm after the documented activation procedure. Initial white-only behavior resolved; the internal cause remains unproven.

These results used 0.1.2-1. Version 0.1.3-1 has identical installed binaries/resources; the newly versioned package upgrade has not been tested on device. These exact configurations do not establish blanket iOS or jailbreak support.

- At the same brightness, switching between Lantern and Apple's flashlight may require a second interaction before physical output changes.
- Apple's expanded flashlight active indicator may appear while Lantern operates.

**Owner-observed:** iPhone 14 Pro / iOS 17.0 (21A329), Dopamine rootless: selecting Lantern crashes SpringBoard during Control Center initialization and enters Safe Mode. Cause unknown; iPhone 14 Pro warm-light capability is unverified.

**External tester report, not independently verified:** iPhone 11 Pro / iOS 18.1.1, converted RootHide installation: control appears but physical output reportedly remains white. Conversion alone does not establish compatibility.

**Other unverified reports:** Safe Mode on iOS 16.5.1 and functionality on other iOS 18 configurations; exact causes and broader support remain unknown.

If a crash or Safe Mode occurs, stop testing and preserve existing reports. Do not reproduce a crash to collect logs.

Version-only metadata update from 0.1.2-1. All installed binaries and resources are byte-identical. No functional code, hooks, LED mapping, injection filters, dependencies or activation behavior changed. The same-intensity handoff limitation remains.

Lantern code and project documentation: 0chium and Lantern contributors. Credit to PoomSmart for earlier ISP LED-control work in Amber.
